handoffs.when: When Delivery Engineer classifies the outcome as Delivery Completed after explicit user verification, repository finalization, and every applicable release, publication, deployment, rollout, and safe-cleanup step is Completed or truthfully Not required. Include the complete cumulative package, final validation evidence, delivery and finalization artifacts, user-verification reference, final branch/commit/merge/push state, release or deployment outcome, and durable artifact paths for Requirements Engineer to verify and return.
When delivery discovers a code or packaging Local Fix that must be corrected by implementation before finalization can continue.
When delivery discovers a Design Impact, Requirement Gap, or Unclear issue, or final handoff is blocked by a non-deployment issue that requires upstream classification.

decision: No rule applies. Delivery Completed is false; no code/packaging Local Fix; no Design Impact, Requirement Gap, Unclear issue or non-deployment blocker requiring upstream classification. Normal user-verification hold remains Delivery-owned. No inter-agent message or terminal success sent.
